name: Create a Web Analytics rule
description: Create a Web Analytics rule Creates a new rule in a Web Analytics ruleset. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/rum/v2/{ruleset_id}/rule
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/rum/v2/{ruleset_id}/rule
Creates a new rule in a Web Analytics ruleset.
Required: account_id (path); ruleset_id (path); body (body)

name: Create a Web Analytics site
description: Create a Web Analytics site Creates a new Web Analytics site. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/rum/site_info
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/rum/site_info
Creates a new Web Analytics site.
Required: account_id (path); body (body)

name: Delete a Web Analytics rule
description: Delete a Web Analytics rule Deletes an existing rule from a Web Analytics ruleset. DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/rum/v2/{ruleset_id}/rule/{rule_id}

name: Delete a Web Analytics site
description: Delete a Web Analytics site Deletes an existing Web Analytics site. DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/rum/site_info/{site_id}

name: Get a Web Analytics site
description: Get a Web Analytics site Retrieves a Web Analytics site. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/rum/site_info/{site_id}

name: List rules in Web Analytics ruleset
description: List rules in Web Analytics ruleset Lists all the rules in a Web Analytics ruleset. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/rum/v2/{ruleset_id}/rules
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/rum/v2/{ruleset_id}/rules
Lists all the rules in a Web Analytics ruleset.
Required: account_id (path); ruleset_id (path)

name: List Web Analytics site tags
description: List Web Analytics site tags Returns all site tags for an account as an array of site tag strings. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/rum/site_info/site_tag/list
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/rum/site_info/site_tag/list
Returns all site tags for an account as an array of site tag strings. This endpoint returns all results without pagination.
Required: account_id (path)
Optional: all (query) — When true, includes sites that are disabled or paused.

name: List Web Analytics sites
description: List Web Analytics sites Lists all Web Analytics sites of an account. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/rum/site_info/list
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/rum/site_info/list
Lists all Web Analytics sites of an account.
Required: account_id (path)
Optional: per_page (query); page (query); order_by (query)

name: List Web Analytics zone tags
description: List Web Analytics zone tags Returns all zone tags associated with Web Analytics sites for an account. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/rum/site_info/zone_tag/list
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/rum/site_info/zone_tag/list
Returns all zone tags associated with Web Analytics sites for an account. These can be used to filter or exclude zones in the zone selection input. This endpoint returns all results without pagination.
Required: account_id (path)

name: Update Web Analytics rules
description: Update Web Analytics rules Modifies one or more rules in a Web Analytics ruleset with a single request. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/rum/v2/{ruleset_id}/rules
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/rum/v2/{ruleset_id}/rules
Modifies one or more rules in a Web Analytics ruleset with a single request.
Required: account_id (path); ruleset_id (path); body (body)

name: Update a Web Analytics rule
description: Update a Web Analytics rule Updates a rule in a Web Analytics ruleset. PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/rum/v2/{ruleset_id}/rule/{rule_id}

name: Update a Web Analytics site
description: Update a Web Analytics site Updates an existing Web Analytics site. PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/rum/site_info/{site_id}

name: Validate a Web Analytics site hostname
description: Validate a Web Analytics site hostname Validates that the provided hostname is well-formed, does not contain wildcards, and has a valid TLD. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/rum/site_info/validate/{hostname}
